answer: The circuit had two bugs. First, "cx" is not an IQM native gate. The native gates are prx, cz, and measure. I rebuilt the CNOT as prx(-pi/2, phase pi/2) on the target, then cz, then prx(+pi/2, phase pi/2) on the target. Second, QB25 does not exist on garnet, which has QB1 to QB20 only. I used QB2 as the partner, since QB1-QB2 is a cz coupler in the garnet:mock architecture. The first prx on QB1 was kept. Both qubits are measured under key "m". I ran it on garnet:mock with 100 shots as job 01a15f18-75ad-7730-b3bf-a6897c604965. The counts were 00: 54 and 11: 46, a clean Bell pair with no 01 or 10. The fixed circuit is saved at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_1a6926f8-f6c-61/bell_fixed.json. Nothing was committed.
